children: Turkey’s manufacturing coincidence index fell to 102 in September 2026 from 102.8 in the previous month, marking the lowest reading since April.

The decline was driven by weaker production and export expectations, with output over the next three months falling to 115.6 from 121.1 in August, while export orders for the coming three months dropped to 111.9 from 118.3.
Expectations for fixed investment expenditure also eased to 104.9 from 105.5, and total orders over the past three months edged down to 104.2 from 104.4.
However, firms reported stronger current orders, rising to 87.8 from 84.8, while employment expectations increased to 104.4 from 103.3.
Inventories of finished goods fell to 96.9 from 98.1, indicating lower stock levels, while expectations for the general business situation improved to 90.4 from 86.7.

title: Turkey Manufacturing Confidence Falls to 5-Month Low
